sum: Runs several coding agents side by side, each in its own git worktree, and puts the comparison of their results in front of a person before anything is merged.
art: parallel git worktrees and their diffs (persistent)

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 3 of the 5 neutral interface standards (MCP, AGENTS.md, Agent Skills)
evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: local-first, the operator's state stays on their machine; keys are the operator's own (byok)
evidence.se.threats: cites th and ctrl: T2/T10/T11/T13 introduced, controls sandbox part, approval impl, log part, kill part, agentauth none
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec and ctrl: the entry executes, and its reach is bounded by approval impl, sandbox part
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format vcs-history: commits and branches, which git reads without the tool
evidence.pe.budget: a ceiling the operator sets on the command line: docs/site/content/docs/cli/orchestration.mdx (--timeout)
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline (README.md)
evidence.ic.error: a documented flag that gates or previews the action: docs/site/content/docs/cli/reference.mdx (--dry-run)
evidence.rl.resume: a resume the operator can ask for: docs/site/content/docs/agents/session-history.mdx (--resume)
evidence.se.attest: signs or attests what it publishes: .github/workflows/cloud-deploy-relay-asia-topology.yml (sha256sum)
evidence.fx.install: only a global install is documented: README.md (brew install )
evidence.fx.byo: the entry does not call a model provider itself, so there is no provider for the operator to substitute
evidence.sf.stop: stopping is described in prose only: docs/site/content/docs/cli/reference.mdx (Ctrl-C)
evidence.sf.warn: the irreversible step is both warned about and gated: config/i18n-translation-source.md (Destructive)

pre: subscriptions or keys for the agents being run
a repository where several worktrees are practical
a person willing to compare and choose
anti: work where running the same prompt five times is simply five times the cost for one answer
headless environments, since the product is an interface
gnote: Isolation by git worktree rather than by container: cheap, and enough to keep agents from overwriting each other while a person picks a winner. Fanning one prompt across five agents multiplies cost by five for a single accepted result, which is the trade being made deliberately.

ja.sum: 複数のコーディングエージェントをそれぞれ独立したgit worktreeで並走させ、結果の比較を人の前に置いてからマージする。
ja.art: 並列のgit worktreeとその差分（永続）
pre: 走らせるエージェント分のサブスクリプションまたはキー
worktreeを複数張れるリポジトリ
anti: 同じプロンプトを5回走らせることが、1つの答えに5倍払うだけになる作業
画面が製品であるため、ヘッドレス環境
ja.gnote: 隔離をコンテナではなくgit worktreeで行う。安価で、人が勝者を選ぶ間エージェント同士の上書きを防ぐには十分である。1つのプロンプトを5エージェントに広げることは、採用される1件のために5倍払うことであり、その取引は意図的になされている。
